title: KoveeEndeavorFormCommand (DESIGN.md §16.3 verbatim; stable semantic command bytes; C2, R39)
description: KoveeEndeavorFormCommand (§16.3 verbatim): the stable semantic command bytes. canonical_command_digest covers only this object — it excludes attempt id/nonce, authentication observation/proof, transport request id, and send time; a retry preserves these bytes and replaces only the expiring proof/binding envelope. The authenticated delegated principal is the only author; the server recomputes the actor binding, IdempotencyDomain, canonical Endeavor subject, eligibility, control domains, active governance rule, and slot snapshot — request fields can only match those values (§16.3). Requires an already active Society, human Participant, Standing, Society recovery epoch, KoveeRealmByomBinding, and KoveeSocietyMapping; it never bootstraps a Society.

endeavor_proposal.description: The canonical EndeavorProposal subject body, carried opaque here and pinned by endeavor_proposal_digest; its exact shape is normatively owned by the B0.1 endeavor_propose subject. The server recomputes the canonical Endeavor subject — this field can only match it (§16.3).

source_principal_position.description: The source principal's own explicit Position filling the sole computed formation seat, carried opaque and pinned by source_principal_position_digest; shape owned by the B0.1 endeavor_position subject. The operation cannot import an offline Position or fill another Participant's seat (§16.3).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.

key_ref.description: Per-Society index key id; the raw key is never part of the ref.

idempotencyDomainDigest.description: The IdempotencyDomain digest (§14.2; PROFILE.md §5, D-R0-1): always the keyed scope_erasure_safe class over the per-Society index key — a public class here is a conformance failure.
